name: Comicpress
tagline: Converts and compresses comics and manga for ereaders
blurb: Comicpress takes DRM-free comic book files (CBR, CBZ, PDF) and compresses them to a fraction of their original size while improving how they look on e-ink ereaders.
description:
Comicpress takes DRM-free comic book files (CBR, CBZ, PDF) and compresses
them to a fraction of their original size while improving how they look on
e-ink ereaders. It applies image-processing operations such as contrast
stretching, high-quality scaling, quantization, and dithering, all of
which can be customized or disabled.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
